notes.title: Catalyst Update - Available Now
notes.notes:
The Catalyst Update is now available for all players! I'm most likely going to forget a few changes, but here's the ones I can recall:

FEATURES
- A new act featuring 7 new levels
- A new NPC
- Simplified Chinese support
- 4 new tutorial levels
- An Undo button

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a bug that causing leaderboard entries to be uploaded to incorrect levels, leading to impossible scores

This is the last major update I intend to release for Photochemistry. It's been a fun time, but I think I'm going to move on to a new project after this one (it may be a while). Bug fixes or small features may still be added. If I ever come out with a new project, I'll be sure to post it both here and on the community Discord!

I hope you all enjoy the new content.

Thank you for your continued support,
Thomas

notes.title: Catalyst Update Release Date (+ free copies for content creators)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Hope you're having a good Halloween. I'm excited to announce the release date for the upcoming Catalyst Update.

The Catalyst Update will release on November 10th, 2024

That's just 10 days away! I hope you'll enjoy the new content as much as I enjoyed making it.
How will you access the new content?
A new door will be open after the end of act 2. Just follow the blue light.

Free Giveaways and Early Access for Content Creators
Know a Youtuber, Twitch streamer, or other content creator who want to see play Photochemistry? I'm giving away free copies along with early access to the Catalyst Update to any content creator who uploads regularly, no matter how small the audience! If you or someone you know is a content creator, get in touch at contact@thomashorne.ca.
